presentation.title: 👋 Hi, I'm Florent
presentation.subtitle: Backend .NET Developer — future Provençal seeking a permanent position
presentation.seekingJobBanner: 🟢 Available for a permanent position from September 2026 — Marseille · Aix-en-Provence · Toulon
presentation.locationBadge: Currently in Amiens — Moving to Provence in September 2026
presentation.firstParagraph1: Originally from Nogent-le-Rotrou, in the heart of Normandy's Perche region, I grew up surrounded by nature and a growing curiosity for technology.
presentation.firstParagraph2: It all started at age 14 with the discovery of Python — a true revelation. The Computer Science elective in high school only amplified that passion.
presentation.firstParagraph3: I then built my foundation in Amiens with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science at the IUT, before going further with a Master's in Cloud Computing & Mobility at INSSET in Saint-Quentin — a demanding program that I fully embraced as an apprentice at Orange Business.
presentation.secondParagraph: I'm a Backend Developer specialized in .NET & C#. My playground: clean RESTful APIs, solid clean architecture, SQL Server, and well-thought-out dependency injection. I also do front-end work with Vue.js — which gives me a useful dual perspective for documenting my APIs precisely. But backend is where I truly thrive.
presentation.philosophyText: Before writing a single line of code, I make sure I fully understand the business need and the end goal. I start by designing the database architecture and API contracts, then build brick by brick, keeping code clean, testable, and maintainable. When a bug hits, no band-aids — I trace it to the root, fix the flaw, and write a test to make sure it never comes back.

values.knowledgeSharing: Knowledge sharing & kind code reviews to progress together
values.documentation: Careful documentation (Swagger, README) to make work and maintenance easier
values.pragmatism: Rigor & pragmatism: understand before coding, fix at the source

presentation.goalText: At the end of my studies, in September 2026, I'm moving to Provence — my family is there, and that's where I want to build the next chapter of my career. I'm looking for a permanent position in software development in Marseille, Aix-en-Provence or Toulon, ideally backend-focused, within a team where code quality and good atmosphere matter as much as technical skills.
presentation.goalCTA: Permanent role in Marseille · Aix-en-Provence · Toulon — from Sept. 2026

first.title: Full-Stack .NET / Vue.js Developer — Internship
first.shortDesc: Immersion with the Microsoft development team for my first steps in professional software development.
first.content: End-of-year internship during my 2nd year of BUT in Computer Science. Immersion with the Microsoft development team for my first professional steps. Deep dive into object-oriented programming and the modern .NET ecosystem. Integrated into a team of consultants, I discovered the .NET Core world in real conditions.
first.tech: C# · ASP.NET Core (.NET 6) · Vue.js · Vuetify · AngularJS · SQL Server · Entity Framework Core · Dependency Injection · AutoMapper

second.title: Back-end .NET API Developer — Fixed-term Contract
second.shortDesc: Direct follow-up to the spring internship to accelerate Traducto project development.
second.content: Following my internship, I was hired on a fixed-term contract to accelerate the Traducto project development and strengthen the technical quality of the solution. I continued and extended the initial project by developing a new clean architecture API and an internal web back office. Strong skill development in software quality culture.
second.tech: C# · ASP.NET Core (.NET 6) · Clean Architecture · CQRS (MediatR) · xUnit · FluentValidation · Azure DevOps · Swagger

third.title: Full-Stack .NET & TypeScript Consultant — Apprenticeship
third.shortDesc: Consultant apprentice taking ownership of complete projects with increased responsibility.
third.content: Evolution to an apprentice consultant position. Taking ownership of complete projects and increasing responsibility for architecture and deployments. Consultant on Microsoft and JavaScript technologies within an Agile team. Development and maintenance of REST APIs in ASP.NET Core (clean architecture, CQRS), front-end development with Vue.js 3 and Angular on internal business applications.
third.tech: C# · ASP.NET Core (.NET 6/.NET 8) · Angular · Vue.js 3 · TypeScript · SQL Server · Entity Framework Core · REST / SOAP APIs · Whisper AI API · Docker · Azure DevOps · Agile (Scrum)

first.title: Bachelor in Computer Science (BUT)
first.school: IUT — Université de Picardie Jules Verne, Amiens
first.parcours: Track: Application Development — design, development, validation
first.content1: Intensive three-year university technology program covering the complete software development lifecycle. The first two years focused on technical foundations (algorithms, OOP, databases, software architecture), followed by a third year as an apprentice at Orange Business.
first.content2: Rigorous mastery of algorithms, object-oriented programming (C#, Java, Python, C++, PHP), software design (UML, ERD, design patterns) and application of best practices. Strong emphasis on code quality through writing unit and integration tests. Solid fundamentals in networking (TCP/IP) and Linux server administration.
first.content3: Elected student representative on the IUT Amiens Council. Active participation in council meetings, representation of student interests, and contribution to academic direction. Development of strong communication, leadership, and decision-making process skills.

second.title: Master's — Cloud Computing and Mobility
second.school: INSSET — Université de Picardie Jules Verne, Saint-Quentin
second.content: Advanced Bac+5 program focused on Cloud architectures, DevOps practices, and distributed systems, completed as an apprentice at Orange Business.
second.content1: Advanced Bac+5 program in Cloud architectures, DevOps, and distributed systems. Rigorous and modern curriculum aligned with current industry challenges. Completed as an apprentice at Orange Business, it combines solid theoretical teaching with immediate practical application to develop engineers capable of designing and deploying scalable and resilient Cloud infrastructures.
second.content2: In-depth specialization in Cloud infrastructure (IaaS/PaaS) across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud environments. Mastery of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM Templates), advanced containerization and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes (Swarm, K8s), and Cloud-native and microservices architecture design. Learning of Cloud network architecture, virtualization, and advanced DevOps practices with complex CI/CD pipelines and automation.
second.content3: Development of SaaS-mode applications, creation of cross-platform and native mobile applications (iOS, Android) connected to the Cloud, Big Data and Cloud Data Management, Cloud environment security and audit, Internet of Things (IoT), and Artificial Intelligence integration. Final project: designing and developing a competitive trivia game (Tuuuur) applying Cloud architectural principles.
